definition.simple: A small piece of ownership in a company. Own one share and you own a tiny part of the business.
definition.balanced: Each share gives a claim on part of the company's profits and assets, and usually a vote. Your fraction of the company = your shares ÷ all the shares outstanding. The price of a share is set by buyers and sellers on a [[stock-exchange]], not by the company.

example: A fictional company has 100 million shares. Owning 1,000 of them means owning 1,000 ÷ 100,000,000 = 0.001% of it.
